notes.title: Astronite lands at Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase !!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/21fe38cc9cc343608eac0a4d57af7c9b9a764cb5.png[/img]
Dreamhack Beyond Indie Showcase is here and we are so excited to land in this amazing event in Steam store.

Do you know Astronite?. It's a 1-bit metroidvania created by Dume Games Studio, a solo dev!. This amazing game has a big map full of secrets, enemies and lethal bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/a72c87d543b6224d99705fbbea4502b83058b55f.gif[/img]

Play the demo on Steam and enjoy with the beginning of this fantastic adventure.
⬇️[b]Don't forget to add Astronite to your wishlist[/b]⬇️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489590/Astronite/

See you on Neplea, Space explorer!🚀

notes.title: Astronite Landing on Neplea is now available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/97900a9a44742a25bff2170b6ec21547e50c243c.gif[/img]

[b][h2]Hello space explorers![/h2][/b]

Welcome to Neplea, Astronite's home planet. A wonderful place from which its inhabitants had to leave some time ago because of a small problem with an evil being... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/a72c87d543b6224d99705fbbea4502b83058b55f.gif[/img]

But here is Astronite. His most important mission is to return to Neplea and defeat this evil being once and for all. Would you like to play the beginning of this wonderful metroidvania created by Solo Dev?

[b]Download Astronite Landing on Neplea now and don't forget to add Astronite to your wishlist[/b].


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1489590/Astronite/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/3ef56167926bb745b69ea5c8543b428a8b4270a2.png[/img][/url]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Kk7B2wLb64

notes.title: Astronite on Gamescom 2022
notes.content:
Good morning to everyone and welcome to Gamescom 2022!

We are very exited to tell you about this. [b]If you're on Gamescom you can play Astronite at our booth![/b]. 

We are at [b]Booth IAHOL: Hall 10.2, Booth E-010g-D-021g[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39271408/c03f73f8650e52dc3364fc555ed4792cf01a83e6.png[/img]

Go now to our booth to play and talk about the game. Play the full version with all the secrets and bosses!.

One more thing: we have a new contest on our twitter account. If you take a photo at our booth with us you can win 4 keys of our latest realeases. 

More info in this link:

[url=www.twitter.com/jandusoft][b]www.twitter.com/jandusoft[/b][/url]
